name: @cotal-ai/herdr
description: Cotal Herdr integration: a Herdr Runtime provider for spawning agents into panes of a dedicated Herdr session.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle && pnpm run manifest
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
